svg.text: cut into the lit riser below the bench: a straight-stroke type sign and the numeral; a draft is scratched, not cut
three offset slabs, 7 px wide and under 6 px tall; a draft has its top stone lying beside it
a benchmark tablet set flush in the bench; rim nicks carry the type; a draft is an open ring
a weathering pothole holding dark water; a draft is a dry hollow
a dark sphere weathered out of the sandstone, half buried; a draft is smaller and paler
a thin upright slab; the council rejects it because a row becomes a bar chart
DETAIL AT 3× · PAPER, PATENT, SYSTEM, POST, DRAFT
